claims.text: Animate this photo: bring it to life with slow drifting motion.

The HERO panel shows an adult standing in profile facing left on a rain-soaked rooftop or walkway at night, with wet reflective paving, metal railings on both sides, and out-of-focus city lights behind.
The adult has dark hair shaved at the sides and gathered into a small topknot or bun at the back, and a visible scar through one eyebrow.
The adult wears a black collared jacket over a black shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up boots.
The HERO panel uses cool blue-gray night lighting with warm amber bokeh highlights and a palette dominated by black, charcoal, and cool blue-gray tones.
The animation adds slow, restrained motion: rain streaks drift, the subject shifts his weight, lowers his shoulders, and gradually turns his head from profile toward the viewer.

description.text: In a rain-soaked rooftop walkway at night,

stands in profile facing left, arms relaxed at his sides. Wet paving mirrors distant amber city bokeh beyond metal railings on both sides, while cool blue-gray light edges his black collared jacket with strap and buckle hardware, black shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots. Rain streaks drift through the dark air; the small bun gathered at the back of his head and the scar through one eyebrow remain clear against the low-key background. He settles his weight onto his back foot, lets his shoulders ease down, and a faint shift in his stance sends small highlights across the wet jacket fabric. The pose stays grounded and quiet, with the reflective paving extending toward the out-of-focus city lights.
Rain streaks cross the cool blue-gray night; wet paving and metal railings hold amber bokeh reflections.
lowers his shoulders and shifts his weight, with the jacket collar and cargo pockets moving slightly.
Still on the same rain-slicked rooftop,

turns his head from the left profile toward the viewer. The scar through his eyebrow tightens faintly as his gaze comes around; water beads on his jacket collar catch the warm amber bokeh, and the small bun at the back of his head becomes visible as his neck turns. Rain continues to drift past the metal railings, streaking the cool blue-gray night, while wet reflections shiver across the paving at his boots. His shoulders remain lowered, and the black layers of shirt, cargo trousers, and jacket hold the same dark silhouette against the city glow. The turn is slow and contained, keeping the motion drifting rather than abrupt.
Water beads on the jacket collar catch warm amber highlights; the rain-slicked paving churns with faint reflections.
turns his head from the left profile toward the viewer, the scarred eyebrow tightening faintly as the bun at the back of his head becomes visible.
His stance settles again; rain continues to drift past the railings and across the dark city backdrop.
